intent: 篝火余烬火星：橙红色发光的小火星从画面底部持续升起，被风吹向右上方，带轻微湍流抖动；深暖色近黑背景，密度适中（能看清单颗火星，不是雾也不是稀疏几颗）
pass_criteria: particles read as small GLOWING embers — warm orange/amber with additive glow, not flat dots
clear rising + rightward drift visible when comparing the t1 and t4 frames
slight turbulent wander — trajectories not perfectly straight
background near-black with a warm tint; embers clearly pop
moderate density — individual embers readable; neither fog nor a handful

prior_iterations.critique: Rising motion confirmed (t1: particles confined to lower half; t4: filled frame — oldest particles reached top). Background near-black warm: good. Density: individual embers readable, acceptable. TWO failures: (1) particles are too dim and small — they read as faint dust motes or distant fireflies, not HOT embers; cores need to feel luminous (brighter amber, stronger glow, slightly larger). (2) rightward wind drift is not readable comparing t1→t4 — the cloud envelope looks horizontally symmetric; the oldest (topmost) particles should visibly lean right. Note: true ember fade-out (size/opacity over life) is a CUSTOM_VALUE curve — unscriptable, would need a .ffx preset; not blocking pass.
